originStory.title: Why Knowii Exists
originStory.subtitle: More than knowledge management. A complete system for thriving.
originStory.story: I didn't build Knowii just because I was overwhelmed by information. I built it because I needed systems that worked through everything life threw at me: a failed startup that cost **200k€** and two years. Crushing shyness that made me terrified of communication. The painful transition from introverted engineer to leader and manager. **Burnout** from trying to do everything through willpower. Losing loved ones and questioning what really matters. Raising **three kids** while building a business alongside a demanding corporate career. Through all of this, I realized that information overload was just one symptom of a deeper problem. What I actually needed, what we all need, is a **complete system** for clarity, learning, organization, and execution—PLUS the AI skills to amplify everything. That's what Knowii delivers: a **community of practice** where we share Knowledge Management techniques, AI mastery, and the full toolkit for thriving as a modern knowledge worker.
originStory.inspirationPoint: Knowledge management is the foundation. AI mastery is the accelerator. Together, they create an unfair advantage.

creatorJourney.title: 20+ Years Building Systems. Hundreds of Hours Mastering AI.
creatorJourney.subtitle: Not just theory. Battle-tested systems I use daily.
creatorJourney.story: I've been coding since age 8 and writing almost as long. In my IT career, I've been a software developer, technical lead, software architect, solution architect, infrastructure architect, IT security expert, team leader, project manager, CTO, and founder. Today, I work half-time as an IT Solution Architect for a major financial organization while running DeveloPassion, raising 3 kids, and maintaining nearly **10,000 notes** in my personal knowledge system. I've published **3 books**, written **400+ articles** and newsletters, created courses, and built products used by thousands. When AI exploded, I didn't just dabble—I spent **hundreds of hours** mastering it. I built systems for AI ghostwriting, MCP integration, and workflows that actually work. The Knowii Community is where I share ALL of it: Knowledge Management + AI Mastery + the complete framework for becoming a top-tier knowledge worker.
